purpose: Prospective observation only; quality gates dominate all efficiency measures
population: Each complete 84-row canonical V3 DEV evaluation, separately at steps84 and168
output_tokens: Generated token IDs including native EOS; never prompt tokens

correct_semantic_atoms_per_token.numerator: Frozen evaluator true-positive claims + typed gaps + typed uncertainty + owned evidence references
correct_semantic_atoms_per_token.denominator: Generated output token count per example
correct_semantic_atoms_per_token.report: Per-row values and mean/median/p10/p90; distinguish macro from pooled rates

accepted_output_token_cost: Token-length distribution restricted to contract-valid and semantically accepted outputs
timing: Prefill-inclusive generation wall with frozen synchronization boundaries; no invented TTFT or isolated decode rate
prohibited_optimizations: shortening at the expense of completeness
